defaultRules.canvas: One avatar, one position, one image. Never use collages.
defaultRules.positions: Create exactly one start and one end image per avatar unless an exercise is a timed hold.
defaultRules.text: No text or labels baked into production artwork.
defaultRules.review: Movement accuracy takes priority over visual polish.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall holding one dumbbell vertically at chest height, feet about shoulder width.
exercises.endPosition: Sit hips down and back until thighs reach a comfortable squat depth, knees tracking over toes.
formRules: Keep chest tall, heels planted, knees tracking with toes.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.startPosition: Stand under bar with it secured across upper back, feet about shoulder width.
exercises.endPosition: Descend into squat with hips and knees flexed, then show bottom position with heels planted.
formRules: Neutral spine, knees track over toes, bar stays balanced over mid-foot.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.startPosition: Sit fully supported with feet shoulder width on platform and knees bent.
exercises.endPosition: Press platform away until legs are nearly straight without locking knees.
formRules: Back and hips stay against pad, knees track with toes, no knee lockout.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Press
exercises.startPosition: Sit upright with back against pad, feet on platform, knees flexed.
exercises.endPosition: Extend knees and hips to press platform away, stopping short of knee lockout.
formRules: Keep pelvis and back against pad, feet flat, knees aligned with toes.

exercises.name: 45° Leg Press
exercises.startPosition: Recline in 45-degree sled with feet shoulder width and knees bent toward torso.
exercises.endPosition: Drive sled upward until legs are nearly straight without locking knees.
formRules: Keep hips against pad, control depth, knees aligned with toes.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall with feet about shoulder width and arms relaxed or forward.
exercises.endPosition: Lower into a controlled squat with thighs near parallel and heels down.
formRules: Chest tall, heels planted, knees track over toes.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall holding bar at thighs with soft knees.
exercises.endPosition: Hinge hips back while bar travels close to legs to around mid-shin, torso angled forward.
formRules: Neutral spine, hips travel back, slight knee bend, bar stays close.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall holding two dumbbells in front of thighs with soft knees.
exercises.endPosition: Hinge hips back and lower dumbbells along legs to around mid-shin.
formRules: Neutral spine, slight knee bend, dumbbells stay close to legs.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.startPosition: Sit with upper back against bench, bar across hips, feet planted, hips lowered.
exercises.endPosition: Drive hips upward until torso and thighs form a straight line.
formRules: Chin tucked, ribs down, shins near vertical at top, no lower-back overextension.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.startPosition: Lie on back with knees bent, feet planted, hips resting on floor.
exercises.endPosition: Lift hips until shoulders, hips, and knees form a straight line.
formRules: Drive through feet, ribs down, avoid arching lower back.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.startPosition: Rear foot elevated on bench, front foot planted, torso upright.
exercises.endPosition: Lower rear knee toward floor while front knee bends, keeping balance over front foot.
formRules: Front heel stays planted, knee tracks over toes, hips stay square.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall with feet under hips.
exercises.endPosition: Step one foot back and lower both knees until rear knee nears floor.
formRules: Front heel planted, torso controlled, front knee tracks over toes.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.startPosition: Stand facing a stable box or bench with one foot placed fully on top.
exercises.endPosition: Drive through elevated foot to stand tall on box with hips and knee extended.
formRules: Whole foot on platform, avoid pushing excessively from trailing leg.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.startPosition: Lie on flat bench holding bar above chest with arms extended.
exercises.endPosition: Lower bar under control toward mid-chest with elbows bent.
formRules: Feet planted, shoulder blades set, wrists stacked, bar path controlled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.startPosition: Lie on flat bench with dumbbells above chest and arms extended.
exercises.endPosition: Lower dumbbells beside chest with elbows bent and forearms near vertical.
formRules: Feet planted, shoulders stable, wrists stacked over elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.startPosition: Lie on floor with knees bent, dumbbells above chest, arms extended.
exercises.endPosition: Lower upper arms until triceps contact floor, elbows bent.
formRules: Wrists stacked, ribs controlled, upper arms stop on floor.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.startPosition: Sit with back against pad, handles at chest height, elbows bent.
exercises.endPosition: Press handles forward until arms are nearly straight.
formRules: Shoulders stay down and back, wrists neutral, no elbow lockout.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.startPosition: High plank with hands under shoulders, body in straight line.
exercises.endPosition: Lower chest toward floor with elbows bending while body stays rigid.
formRules: Head, hips, and heels stay aligned, elbows controlled.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.startPosition: Sit at cable row with torso upright, arms extended toward handle.
exercises.endPosition: Pull handle toward lower ribs with elbows traveling back.
formRules: Avoid leaning back, keep shoulders down, squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.startPosition: Lie or sit chest-supported with arms extended holding handles or dumbbells.
exercises.endPosition: Row elbows back until weights reach sides of torso.
formRules: Chest stays supported, no torso swing, shoulders remain controlled.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.startPosition: Brace one hand and knee on bench, opposite foot grounded, dumbbell hanging from straight arm.
exercises.endPosition: Pull dumbbell toward ribs with elbow traveling back beside torso.
formRules: Back stays flat, hips square, avoid torso rotation.

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.startPosition: Anchor band in front, stand or sit tall with arms extended.
exercises.endPosition: Pull band handles toward ribs with elbows moving back.
formRules: Torso stays still, shoulders down, control band tension.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.startPosition: Sit at pulldown with thighs secured, arms extended overhead on bar.
exercises.endPosition: Pull bar toward upper chest with elbows driving down.
formRules: Avoid excessive lean, shoulders stay down, do not pull behind neck.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.startPosition: Begin hanging on assisted pull-up machine with arms extended and knees or feet supported.
exercises.endPosition: Pull body upward until chin approaches bar level.
formRules: Keep ribs controlled, elbows drive down, avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.startPosition: Hang from bar with arms extended and body controlled.
exercises.endPosition: Pull body upward until chin reaches or passes bar height.
formRules: Avoid kipping, shoulders stay active, control ascent.

exercises.name: Band Lat Pulldown
exercises.startPosition: Anchor band overhead, arms extended with band tension.
exercises.endPosition: Pull elbows down toward ribs while bringing handles toward upper chest.
formRules: Torso stays tall, shoulders down, avoid excessive arch.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.startPosition: Sit with back against pad, handles near shoulder height.
exercises.endPosition: Press handles overhead until arms are nearly straight.
formRules: Back stays against pad, wrists neutral, avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.startPosition: Sit or stand with dumbbells at shoulder height.
exercises.endPosition: Press dumbbells overhead until arms are nearly straight.
formRules: Ribs down, wrists stacked, avoid excessive back arch.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.startPosition: Stand with bar at upper chest and hands just outside shoulders.
exercises.endPosition: Press bar overhead until arms are extended and bar is over mid-foot.
formRules: Glutes and core braced, bar clears face, avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.startPosition: Begin in inverted-V position with hips high and hands on floor.
exercises.endPosition: Bend elbows and lower head toward floor between hands.
formRules: Keep hips high, elbows controlled, head travels forward and down.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.startPosition: Lie face down with knees aligned to machine pivot and roller above heels, legs nearly straight.
exercises.endPosition: Curl heels toward glutes by bending knees while hips stay down.
formRules: Hips and thighs stay against pad, control roller, no hip lift.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.startPosition: Sit with back against pad, knees bent, roller above ankles.
exercises.endPosition: Extend knees until legs are nearly straight.
formRules: Back stays against pad, align knees with machine pivot, avoid snapping lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides, elbows slightly bent.
exercises.endPosition: Raise arms out to sides to about shoulder height.
formRules: Lead with elbows, shoulders down, avoid swinging.

exercises.name: Band Lateral Raise
exercises.startPosition: Stand on or anchor band with hands at sides.
exercises.endPosition: Raise arms out to sides against band tension to about shoulder height.
formRules: Keep torso still, shoulders down, control tension.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides and palms forward or neutral.
exercises.endPosition: Curl dumbbells toward shoulders while elbows remain close to torso.
formRules: Keep elbows near sides, no torso swing, wrists neutral.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.startPosition: Stand facing cable with arms extended down holding handle.
exercises.endPosition: Curl handle toward shoulders while elbows stay near sides.
formRules: Keep torso still, elbows fixed, control cable.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.startPosition: Stand at cable with elbows bent and tucked, bar or rope near lower chest.
exercises.endPosition: Extend elbows to press attachment down until arms are straight.
formRules: Upper arms stay close to torso, wrists neutral, no shoulder swing.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.startPosition: Stand or sit holding one dumbbell overhead with elbows bent.
exercises.endPosition: Extend elbows to raise dumbbell overhead until arms are nearly straight.
formRules: Keep elbows pointed forward, ribs down, avoid back arch.

exercises.name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.startPosition: Stand tall holding dumbbells at sides with feet flat.
exercises.endPosition: Rise onto balls of feet by lifting heels as high as controlled.
formRules: Keep knees softly extended, ankles track straight, pause at top.

exercises.name: Calf Extension Machine
exercises.startPosition: Sit or stand in calf machine with feet on platform and heels lowered.
exercises.endPosition: Press through balls of feet to raise heels and plantar-flex ankles.
formRules: Move through ankles, keep knees stable, avoid bouncing.

exercises.name: Leg Press Calf Raise
exercises.startPosition: Sit in leg press with legs nearly straight and balls of feet on platform, heels slightly lowered.
exercises.endPosition: Press through forefeet to point ankles and raise heels away from platform edge.
formRules: Knees remain softly extended and stable, movement comes from ankles.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.startPosition: Stand on one foot holding dumbbell, heel slightly lowered from step if available.
exercises.endPosition: Rise onto ball of working foot to full controlled calf contraction.
formRules: Keep ankle aligned, knee stable, use support only for balance.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.startPosition: Forearms on floor, elbows under shoulders, body straight from head to heels.
exercises.endPosition: Hold the same rigid plank position for the prescribed time.
formRules: Ribs down, glutes engaged, hips neither sag nor pike.

exercises.name: Sit-Up
exercises.startPosition: Lie on back with knees bent and feet planted.
exercises.endPosition: Curl torso upward toward thighs under control.
formRules: Avoid jerking neck, keep feet planted, control descent.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.startPosition: Lie on back with hips and knees at 90 degrees and arms toward ceiling.
exercises.endPosition: Extend opposite arm and leg away from torso while lower back stays controlled.
formRules: Keep lower back gently pressed down, move slowly, alternate sides.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.startPosition: Kneel facing cable with rope by sides of head, torso upright.
exercises.endPosition: Flex spine and bring ribs toward pelvis while keeping hips mostly fixed.
formRules: Crunch through trunk, avoid pulling only with arms, hips stay controlled.

exercises.name: Prone W Raise
exercises.startPosition: Lie face down with arms bent into a W shape and hands off floor or lightly touching.
exercises.endPosition: Lift elbows and hands slightly while squeezing shoulder blades down and back.
formRules: Keep neck neutral, movement small, avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: Prone Lat Pull-Down
exercises.startPosition: Lie face down with arms extended overhead.
exercises.endPosition: Sweep elbows down toward ribs while lifting arms slightly off floor.
formRules: Keep neck neutral, ribs controlled, squeeze lats without excessive back arch.

exercises.name: Band Overhead Press
exercises.startPosition: Stand on band with handles at shoulder height.
exercises.endPosition: Press handles overhead until arms are nearly straight.
formRules: Ribs down, wrists stacked, control band tension.
